subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw core mutate workspace Markdown at write time, and if so should the behavior be opt-in and parser-backed across gateway, agent-tool, and skill write APIs?
rationale: This is not a broken current contract; it changes persisted workspace content by default and adds config/per-write API surface on stable gateway-adjacent paths.

options.title: Require opt-in parser-backed design
options.body: Keep this issue open, but require maintainer-sponsored design before implementation and avoid default mutation until parser safety and write-path coverage are proven.

options.title: Decline core write-time mutation
options.body: Close or mark not planned if maintainers decide Markdown cleanup belongs in authoring tools, docs linting, or external workspace tooling rather than runtime writes.

options.title: Accept default auto-fix
options.body: Proceed with the original default-on behavior only after explicitly accepting the compatibility and content-mutation risk.

recommendation.title: Require opt-in parser-backed design
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, but require maintainer-sponsored design before implementation and avoid default mutation until parser safety and write-path coverage are proven.

likelyOwner.reason: He is listed as project lead and has the broadest recent signal across the affected current-main paths.
